bio: Ava Rem First-Year Social Committee Crimson Yard Hi! I’m Ava Rem, and I am a first-year from NYC. I currently live in Pennypacker, and am thinking of concentrating in either English or Government (I may even pursue a double concentration, who knows!). Outside of FYSC, you can find me at Lamont writing articles for The Crimson’s flyby blog, interviewing people around campus for my articles for the Harvard Independent, or volunteering with PBHA. In my free time, I enjoy curling up on my couch with a good book, walking to Trader Joe’s to stock up on my cookies and chips, and belting any Noah Kahan or Taylor Swift song with my friends. I am so excited and honored to be part of the lovely FYSC community and help plan some awesome events that will hopefully bring everyone a bit of cheer and happiness during their first year at Harvard. Don’t be afraid to stop me and say hello if you ever see me on campus!
